$comment: CANONICAL F-* feature registry: feature -> required capabilities -> per-device support.
Extracted from the PM prototype set on 2026-08-04. Every feature here EXISTS AS A
BUILT SCREEN in at least one prototype — none is speculative. But 'built as a
prototype screen' is not 'specified': none of these has a PRD, acceptance criteria,
or an error/empty state defined. `prdStatus` says which.

meta.$comment_prd: Zero PRDs exist. docs/features/ is empty. Every F-* below needs one.

F-AQI-LIVE.name: Live air quality
F-AQI-LIVE.why: The #1 stated reason users reopen an air-purifier app. Everything else is built on this.

F-FILTER-HEALTH.name: AQI-weighted filter health
F-FILTER-HEALTH.why: The product's central differentiator AND the consumable-revenue lever. Surfaced too late it becomes a 1-star 'it stopped working' review.
F-FILTER-HEALTH.$comment_vacuum: Vacuum consumables (main brush, side brush, filter, mop pad) use the same wear-percentage pattern but NOT the AQI weighting — that is purifier-only.
F-FILTER-HEALTH.blockedBy: C-7 — the weighting model itself is unspecified.

F-AGENT-PROPOSE.name: Agent proposals with graduated autonomy
F-AGENT-PROPOSE.why: The architectural spine of the product. Determines what the app IS, not just what it shows.
F-AGENT-PROPOSE.$comment_support: Only purifier and vacuum proposals appear in any prototype. Whether the agent may ever act on a LOCK is a safety question nobody has answered — see C-8.

F-FACES.name: Faces You Trust
F-FACES.why: Turns a camera feed into a household roster. Also the mechanism behind scoped access for household staff (persona P3).
F-FACES.compliance: Requires explicit consent under India's DPDP Act 2023. Face data is stated as on-device only, never uploaded. This is a hard legal constraint, not a preference.

F-HOME-SCORE.name: Home Score
F-HOME-SCORE.why: The one number that makes a multi-device home legible, and the hook that makes adding a device feel like progress.
F-HOME-SCORE.blockedBy: C-5 — four incompatible score definitions exist across the source docs.

F-AUTOMATIONS.name: Automations and routines
F-AUTOMATIONS.why: 'Better automations' is the second-strongest stated return-driver after AQI itself.
F-AUTOMATIONS.$comment_trap: The away-mode trap: automations that run silently make the app feel unnecessary. Every automation needs a narration surface, or it erodes the reason to open the app.

F-SHARING.name: Household sharing and scoped access
F-SHARING.why: A home is multi-person. Persona P3 (household help) needs entry without account control.
F-SHARING.blockedBy: C-3 — three incompatible role models exist.
F-SHARING.grantGranularity: Per device type. Camera has 7 distinct grants, lock 2, purifier 2, vacuum 2 — see memory/architecture/data-models.md.

F-WEARABLE-BRIDGE.name: Wearable bridge
F-WEARABLE-BRIDGE.why: Ties air quality to a body metric. The strongest available answer to 'why does clean air matter to me tonight?'
F-WEARABLE-BRIDGE.blockedBy: C-8 — SpO2-driven actuation is health-adjacent and has no medical/legal position.

F-SHOP.name: In-app shop and reorder
F-SHOP.why: Consumables are the recurring revenue. Contextual upsell (persona P4) is the one-device-to-ecosystem funnel.
F-SHOP.$comment_payments: No payment, address, tax, invoice, refund or order-tracking flow exists in any prototype. The shop is a catalogue and a price, nothing behind it.

F-AIR-MAP.name: Home air map
F-AIR-MAP.why: Shows what each room still breathes, making a second device the obvious next step rather than a pop-up.
F-AIR-MAP.openQuestion: The map shows AQI for rooms with NO purifier in them (kitchen 112, living room 94). Those rooms have no sensor. Whether this is inference, interpolation, or invention is unstated — and it is load-bearing for an upsell. Tracked as C-9.

F-WEEK-RECAP.name: Air Week recap and share card
F-WEEK-RECAP.why: Day-7 to Week-2 is the canonical retention chokepoint. The recap is also the cheapest acquisition channel the product gets.
F-WEEK-RECAP.contentRule: Emoji + the number travel; pre-filled brand captions kill shares. The caption must read as the user's, not the company's.

F-NEIGHBOURHOOD.name: Neighbourhood comparison
F-NEIGHBOURHOOD.why: Converts a private utility into a daily check-in and an organic acquisition channel.
F-NEIGHBOURHOOD.compliance: Shows a named neighbour's reading ('Mehta (2F) 54'). Stated as anonymised with the address never shown, but a floor number plus a surname in a small building is not anonymous. Needs a privacy review under DPDP — tracked as C-10.

F-ENERGY.name: Energy and running cost
F-ENERGY.why: 'Is it spiking my electricity bill?' is a quiet usage-suppressor in Indian homes — people switch purifiers off and lose the benefit.
F-ENERGY.openQuestion: Prototype quotes Rs 0.40/hour and Rs 164 saved vs always-Turbo. Both depend on an unstated electricity tariff, which varies by state and slab. Also converts to 'trees worth of clean air' — an equivalence with no cited basis.

capabilityIndex.$comment: Reverse index: which platform capabilities must exist for the features above. None of these is built — this is the shape of the work.
